subject: pr/SharpAstro/pilot#888
title: SharpAstro/pilot#888: the review asks a question of design
detail:
1. Should a stalled worker be restarted or reminded first?
1A. remind it first: restart it only if the reminder does nothing (recommended)
1B. restart it at once
2. Is a leg done when its check passes?
2A. mark it done when its check passes: the review comes after (recommended)
2B. wait for the review too
summary: 1. Should a stalled worker be restarted or reminded first? 2. Is a leg done when its check passes? 2A: mark it done when its check passes (recommended).
